view.en: Third-person 3D: you control a shinobi. Top left: boss name, execution points and health bar; top centre: boss posture bar; bottom left: your health, revive points, gourd and poison/dread gauges; bottom centre: your posture bar. A red danger mark appears over you before a perilous attack.

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bars and land the required executions to win; you lose if health reaches zero with no revive left; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate; only the gourd restores it.

mouse.en: The camera starts free: horizontal mouse (dx) turns it at any time, X>0 turns right. After E locks on, the camera follows the boss and mouse movement has no effect.

keys.en: move forward relative to the camera
tap to dash-step (short dodge with invulnerable start); hold while moving to run; tap during a posture-break stagger to recover faster
jump; press again in the air to kick (used to clear low sweeps)
tap to slash, hold to charge a thrust; a fresh press up close when a red dot shows on the enemy is an execution
hold to guard; a fresh press just before impact is a deflect
drink the gourd to restore health; you cannot attack while drinking
toggle lock-on to the boss (starts unlocked)

notes.en: Fights are won through posture: deflects and hits fill the enemy's posture bar; when full they stagger and can be executed. Your own full posture bar breaks your guard.
Guarding is held; a deflect needs a fresh guard press just before impact. The window is short and mashing shortens it.
Perilous attacks show a red danger mark: dash toward thrusts, jump low sweeps, dash sideways or back out of grabs; none can be guarded.
When lightning strikes, jump to catch it and press attack again before landing to return it.
Full poison or dread gauges drain health or kill instantly; stay away from the source.
Actions are chosen per 200 ms packet, split into 6 sub-steps; press timing is counted in sub-steps.

options.forward_start: W in first half of the packet

act.en: Action: slash, guard, deflect, dash, jump, items (one per packet)

options.deflect_0_4: two deflect presses at sub-steps 1 and 5
options.deflect_0_5: two deflect presses at sub-steps 1 and 6
options.deflect_2_4: two deflect presses at sub-steps 3 and 5
options.deflect_2_5: two deflect presses at sub-steps 3 and 6
options.deflect_3_5: two deflect presses at sub-steps 4 and 6
options.step_alt_0: repeated dash-steps from sub-step 1, every other
options.step_alt_1: repeated dash-steps from sub-step 2, every other
options.jump_kick_0: jump then air kick starting sub-step 1
options.jump_kick_1: jump then air kick starting sub-step 2
options.jump_kick_2: jump then air kick starting sub-step 3
options.jump_kick_3: jump then air kick starting sub-step 4
options.jump_attack_0_1: jump at sub-step 1, slash (lightning return) at 2
options.jump_attack_0_2: jump at sub-step 1, slash (lightning return) at 3
options.jump_attack_0_3: jump at sub-step 1, slash (lightning return) at 4
options.jump_attack_1_2: jump at sub-step 2, slash (lightning return) at 3
options.jump_attack_1_3: jump at sub-step 2, slash (lightning return) at 4
options.jump_attack_1_4: jump at sub-step 2, slash (lightning return) at 5
options.jump_attack_2_3: jump at sub-step 3, slash (lightning return) at 4
options.jump_attack_2_4: jump at sub-step 3, slash (lightning return) at 5
options.jump_attack_2_5: jump at sub-step 3, slash (lightning return) at 6
options.jump_attack_3_4: jump at sub-step 4, slash (lightning return) at 5
options.jump_attack_3_5: jump at sub-step 4, slash (lightning return) at 6
options.jump_attack_4_5: jump at sub-step 5, slash (lightning return) at 6

summary.en: A circular yard before a burning gate. The boss never guards and has hyper armour; it only staggers when its poise breaks. Standing under its belly dodges most attacks.

tell.en: Raises an arm then sweeps forward

effect.en: Single melee hit that costs health and posture

counter.en: Deflect or guard it, or move in under the belly

tell.en: Lifts a foot and holds about a second

counter.en: Sidestep or dash before it lands, then counterattack

tell.en: An arm ignites then slams down

effect.en: Cannot be deflected; guarding only reduces damage and builds burn

counter.en: Dash or back away; do not guard it

tell.en: Hands wave and each wave lobs a fireball

effect.en: Bursts on landing and leaves fire on the ground

counter.en: Dash through or stay clear of landing spots

tell.en: Crouches then leaps high

effect.en: Large explosion on landing; cannot be guarded

counter.en: Run away or be airborne at landing; about a second of opening afterwards

tell.en: A red danger mark appears and the boss rushes
A ring of fire spreads on the ground (third phase)

effect.en: Touching it knocks you back and burns you; comes with a perilous sweep

phases.en: Once burn fills, health drains continuously and posture stops recovering
The third phase adds the fire ring, homing fireballs and a whip of fire

summary.en: A rectangular rooftop arena. He mixes sword and bow and has several health bars; in the last he becomes a lightning-calling swordsman.

tell.en: Raises his sword for a straight cut

effect.en: Single hit costing health and posture

tell.en: Two opening cuts, a spin, then many cuts ending in an uppercut

effect.en: Multi-hit string; the last hit pushes both back

counter.en: Deflect each cut; do not mash

tell.en: Red danger mark, blade pointed forward

counter.en: Dash toward him to stomp the thrust for big posture damage

tell.en: Red danger mark, blade sweeps low

counter.en: Jump it; kick in the air

tell.en: Red danger mark, he reaches out
Backs off and draws his bow, firing single or charged arrows

effect.en: Arrows hurt; charged shots have armour

tell.en: Final bar: he crouches and leaps, then lightning strikes (danger mark)

effect.en: Bolt along a line or arc; very heavy damage

counter.en: Jump to catch the bolt in the air, then press attack before landing to return it

tell.en: You drink while he is idle

effect.en: He always answers with a charged shot or a dive thrust

counter.en: Do not drink while he stands idle

phases.en: The first two bars are the swordsman; the last becomes the lightning swordsman with bolts
Each bar needs an execution to finish

summary.en: A round valley pool. First form: a hyper-armoured four-legged beast with poison. Second form: a headless apparition with a sword.

tell.en: Raises fists and slams four times
Red danger mark, a huge arm sweeps to grab
Danger mark, it throws itself down

effect.en: Body slam that cannot be jumped

tell.en: Releases a gas cloud then flees and throws dung

effect.en: Fills the poison gauge; once full, health drains

counter.en: Leave the cloud and dodge the throw

tell.en: Headless form chops four times
Headless form leaps and dives

effect.en: Heavy hit; afterwards its neck is exposed

counter.en: Deflect or dodge, then attack the exposed neck

tell.en: Headless form throws back its head and roars (danger mark)

effect.en: Fills the dread gauge; full means instant death; guarding is useless

tell.en: Danger mark, jump then heavy slam

effect.en: Heavy damage; deflect for big posture damage

phases.en: The first execution is fake; it rises again with a hidden bar
The second form drops poison and uses the roar to build dread

summary.en: A large circular yard before a gate. The mounted boss never guards and has hyper armour until poise breaks; there is no grappling hook, and after riding off he always charges back.

tell.en: Three close cuts

effect.en: The third is heavy; deflecting it staggers him

tell.en: Danger mark, close spear thrust

counter.en: Dash toward him to stomp it

tell.en: Hooves rise when you stand directly behind
Danger mark, he gallops at you

effect.en: Rides through, then rides off and turns back

tell.en: Circles you with repeated strikes
Swings a roped spearhead in wide circles
Danger mark, spearhead shot in a line

effect.en: Line attack that cannot be guarded

tell.en: Leaps then slams twice

phases.en: Hits land but cannot interrupt him; jumping cuts above the waist deal large posture damage

summary.en: A circular grass field. First a lightning swordsman, then the old master with sword, with spear and matchlock, and finally with lightning added.

tell.en: Two crossing cuts
Red blade wave at range (unblockable)
Black-red blade spreads out
Sword launches a wave

effect.en: Guarding bleeds health; deflecting does not hurt posture

counter.en: Sidestep vertical waves; jump flat ones

tell.en: Pose then perilous thrust

counter.en: Dash toward him to stomp it

tell.en: Spear danger-mark sweep
Backs off and fires four times, the last delayed

effect.en: Guarding costs much posture; deflecting costs less

counter.en: Dash or deflect; a perilous attack always follows

tell.en: Cannot be interrupted while charging; bolt falls

phases.en: Lightning swordsman, sword, spear and matchlock, then lightning added; several bars

summary.en: A courtyard with rows of pillars. She uses threads, kunai and aerial grabs; the second phase adds illusions and homing butterflies.

tell.en: Throws two kunai in quick succession
Two cuts then a downward strike
Danger mark, two low sweeps
She climbs a thread, then dives with a danger mark
Summons decoys that become homing butterflies

counter.en: Slash decoys; run straight and use pillars to block butterflies

tell.en: Kick then many cuts, ending in a perilous sweep

phases.en: After the first execution she rises into the illusion phase
